part_a.rule_application: Predictions were not corrected; properties are measured only.

strict_transitivity.note: A violated triple is not an independent model failure; one predicted edge can participate in many violated triples.

summary.distance_to_admitted_note: nearest_admitted_opposite is distance to admitted canonical training pairs only; it is not distance to the real-R training set
summary.matching_rule: same seen/unseen, |x-b|, expected orientation/action, x-anchor flag, reference-anchor flag; nearest correct feature in normalized z-space

selection.control_selection: first two agreement-correct episodes per (seen, |x-b|, expected orientation)
selection.failure_selection: one lexicographically first episode per category/x/reference

summary.note: Intermediate points are diagnostic interventions, not training examples; no monotonicity or single boundary is assumed.
